name: Databricks
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Databricks is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors, funds and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Databricks is a privately held data and artificial intelligence software company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $5 billion strategic round announced on August 13, 2026, valued the company at $190 billion.

Founded in 2013 and based in San Francisco, Databricks provides a cloud platform that companies use to store, manage and analyze data and to build artificial intelligence applications. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.

table_note: Valuations and amounts raised are as announced by the company, and amounts reflect equity only. The Series L was announced in December 2025 and completed in February 2026.
round_notes: In announcing the August 2026 round, Databricks said it had passed a $7 billion revenue run-rate in its second quarter, with growth of more than 80% year over year; those figures are the company's own.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Coatue led the August 2026 strategic round, joined by Blackstone, MGX, T. Rowe Price and Sixth Street Growth. Insight Partners, Fidelity and J.P. Morgan Asset Management co-led the Series L; Thrive Capital, MGX, Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz and WCM Investment Management co-led the Series K, and Thrive Capital led the Series J. Other investors include NEA, GIC, Temasek, Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, Microsoft and Nvidia.
spv_sentence: Since 2021, 22 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Databricks have filed with the SEC, 10 of them in 2026.
funds: Mutual funds and other SEC-registered funds managed by Fidelity, PIMCO, Capital Group, BlackRock and T. Rowe Price, among others, reported Databricks holdings in filings for periods in 2026. As of July 31, 2026, ARK Venture Fund held 100,728 shares, which it valued at $26.4 million, or $262.31 per share.
sources: Sources: Databricks announcements dated August 13, 2026, February 9, 2026, December 16, 2025, September 8, 2025, August 19, 2025, December 17, 2024, September 14, 2023 and August 31, 2021; ARK Venture Fund's Form N-PORT for July 31, 2026; and SEC Form D and Form N-PORT filings.
